jobs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: isolated reusable orthographic top-view furniture sprite for a high-quality interior floor-planning app. A single refined contemporary dining chair with a subtly curved warm taupe woven-linen upholstered backrest, soft rounded-square upholstered seat, slender natural smoked oak frame just visible at its four edges. Seat toward bottom of image, curved backrest at top. Real physical size 480 mm wide by 520 mm deep; natural proportions, not an armchair, no armrests. Camera perfectly vertical at 90 degrees straight down, true architectural plan projection, zero front elevation and zero isometric perspective. Photorealistic PBR texture, delicate visible weave and restrained seams, softly rounded natural volumes. Neutral even material lighting, internal contact occlusion only; no exterior cast shadows, no studio ground plane. Complete object comfortably framed, large and centered. Genuine transparent alpha background. No props, no table, no floor, no lettering, no measurements, no vignette, no colored outline. Strong well-defined silhouette. Premium furniture visualization matching a greige linen sofa and natural oak table. Square image, detailed fabric.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: single isolated reusable orthographic top-view rug sprite for a high-quality interior floor-planning app. One premium warm light-stone wool and linen flatwoven area rug, physical rectangular proportions 3000 mm wide by 2200 mm tall. Fine tightly woven heathered warm ivory and greige yarns; beautifully subtle irregular natural weave, completely understated pattern, no ornamental motifs, no coarse noise. Thin tone-on-tone stitched binding around perimeter, absolutely no dark borders. Clean straight edges with tiny soft textile irregularity; no long fringe. Camera exactly straight down at 90 degrees, all sides parallel to image edges; entire rectangle visible without perspective. Flat even neutral material illumination, NO cast shadows, NO ground plane. Detailed sharp high resolution textile surface should remain legible and serene when reduced in an architectural plan. Pale stone/cream color distinct from brown oak and greige sofa. Genuine transparent alpha outside the rug only. Centered with a little margin. No furniture, no accessories, no text, no dimension marks, no vignette, no colored halos. Landscape 4:3 image.
